subtitle: Two Battles, One Field, and a Lesson Unlearned

panels.shot: split wide frame, left half low-angle on armoured Rajput king, right half low-angle on mail-clad Ghurid sultan, both facing the same hazy plain of Tarain
panels.action: Prithviraj Chauhan stands on one side in gleaming mail atop a caparisoned horse, Muhammad of Ghor on the other in chain armour with a conical helmet, both gazing toward the same dusty battlefield of Tarain under a blazing sky.

dialogue.text: On the same plain at Tarain, Prithviraj Chauhan first broke Muhammad of Ghor, then fell to him a year later. How did one victory become another man’s empire?

i18n.hi: उसी तराइन के मैदान पर, पृथ्वीराज चौहान ने पहले मुहम्मद गौरी को तोड़ा, और एक साल बाद उसी से हार बैठे। एक जीत दूसरे की सल्तनत कैसे बनी?

panels.shot: epic bird's-eye over north India, with Ajmer and Delhi in the centre and Ghazni-Ghor to the northwest, faint arrows showing pressures
panels.action: A sweeping map-like vista shows the Aravalli hills around Ajmer and Delhi in the centre, rugged Afghan mountains to the northwest, and caravan routes threading the plains under a pale dawn.

dialogue.text: In the late twelfth century, the north Indian plains were a chessboard of rival kings. From Ajmer and Delhi the Chahamanas pressed outward, while from the Afghan highlands the Ghurids pushed in.

i18n.hi: बारहवीं सदी के आखिर में उत्तर भारत मैदानों पर राजाओं की शतरंज बिछी थी। अजमेर–दिल्ली से चाहमान फैल रहे थे, उधर अफ़ग़ान पहाड़ों से घूरियों की चढ़ाई थी।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Prithviraj in court, foreground, and faint ghosted profile of Muhammad far behind, as if two worlds unaware of each other
panels.action: Prithviraj sits in a pillared hall in Ajmer, young yet stern, hand resting on his sword hilt as nobles stand around; far in the background, faintly suggested, Muhammad of Ghor studies a map by lamplight in a stone fortress.

dialogue.text: Prithviraja III ruled from Ajmer and Delhi, the most powerful of the Rajput lords. Muhammad of Ghor, brother of the Ghurid ruler, turned from mountain wars toward the rich Gangetic plains.

i18n.hi: पृथ्वीराज तृतीय अजमेर–दिल्ली का राज करता, राजपूत सरदारों में सबसे ताकतवर। घूर शासक का भाई मुहम्मद गौरी पहाड़ी जंग छोड़कर गंगा के समृद्ध मैदानों की ओर मुड़ा।

panels.shot: medium wide on Muhammad with his commanders around a map, Prithviraj’s domains marked, candlelight flickering
panels.action: Muhammad of Ghor leans over a parchment map marked with rivers and towns like Multan, Lahore, and Delhi, his mailed finger tracing toward the plains as commanders in turbans and helmets listen closely.

dialogue.text: By 1180s, Ghurid armies had taken Ghazni, Multan and Lahore from older dynasties. The chronicles say Muhammad now fixed his gaze on the routes to Ajmer and beyond.

i18n.hi: ११८० के दशक तक घूरी फ़ौजें ग़ज़नी, मुल्तान और लाहौर पुराने घरानों से छीन चुकी थीं। इबारतें लिखती हैं, अब मुहम्मद की नज़रें अजमेर के रास्तों पर टिकीं।

panels.shot: dynamic wide showing Ghurid cavalry crossing the Indus, contrasted with Rajput horsemen drilling in the plains
panels.action: On one side, Muhammad of Ghor leads armoured horsemen over a shallow river, spray flying; on the other, Prithviraj’s kshatriya cavalry wheel in tight circles on a flat, dusty field near Delhi.

dialogue.text: Two styles of war rolled toward each other. Fast, disciplined Ghurid cavalry archers versus heavily armoured Rajput horsemen and infantry, proud of their charges and close combat.

i18n.hi: दो तरह की जंग आमने–सामने चलीं। तेज़, अनुशासनबद्ध घूरी घुड़सवार धनुर्धर, और सामने भारी कवच वाले राजपूत घुड़सवार–पैदल, अपनी टक्कर और हाथापाई पर नाज़ाँ।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of Tarain plain with scrub and wells, both armies approaching from opposite horizons
panels.action: A wide plain near a cluster of wells and trees stretches under the sun, dust plumes rising as two distant armies march from opposite sides toward Tarain.

dialogue.text: In 1191, Muhammad advanced down the route from Lahore toward the heart of the Chahamana realm. Near a place called Taraori, or Tarain, Prithviraj came out to meet him.

i18n.hi: ११९१ में मुहम्मद, लाहौर से चाहमानों के दिल की राह पर उतरा। ताहरौरी, यानी तराइन के पास, पृथ्वीराज उसे रोकने निकल पड़े।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of the two lines forming: Rajput standards and elephants on one side, Ghurid banners and cavalry on the other
panels.action: Facing lines of warriors draw up on the plain, Rajput standards with sun and lion symbols rising above mail-clad horsemen and elephants, opposite Ghurid ranks of mounted archers beneath long, fluttering banners.

dialogue.text: Indian and Persian accounts agree on the broad outline. The two hosts formed up at Tarain, each testing not just steel but ideas of how a war should be fought.

i18n.hi: भारतीय और फ़ारसी दोनों बयानों में रूपरेखा मिलती है। तराइन में दोनों सेनाएँ भिड़ने को सजीं, जहाँ सिर्फ़ इस्पात नहीं, जंग की सोच भी टकराई।

panels.shot: tight, tense medium on Muhammad leading an attack, arrows mid-flight, with Prithviraj’s front line bracing
panels.action: Muhammad of Ghor, sword drawn, urges his cavalry forward as archers loose volleys, while in the foreground Rajput warriors raise shields and lances, faces set.

dialogue.text: The first clash at Tarain was fierce. Later chroniclers say Muhammad hurled himself at the Chahamana centre, only to find his advance stalled by dense ranks and counter-attacks.

i18n.hi: तराइन की पहली टक्कर भयंकर थी। बाद के लिखने वाले बताते हैं, मुहम्मद ने चाहमानों के बीचोंबीच धावा बोला, पर घने मोर्चों और जवाबी हमलों ने क़दम रोक दिए।

panels.shot: dramatic wide of the Ghurid line buckling, with Muhammad being escorted away by bodyguards, Rajputs pressing forward
panels.action: In the melee, Ghurid riders wheel away in disorder as a small knot of bodyguards hustles a grim Muhammad of Ghor back from the front, while Rajput horsemen surge with lowered lances.

dialogue.text: Hasan Nizami and Minhaj-i-Siraj both recall a setback. Muhammad was wounded and forced to retreat, his army falling back toward the northwest while Prithviraj’s forces held the field.

i18n.hi: हसन निज़ामी और मिनहाज-ए-सिराज दोनों इस नाकामी को दर्ज करते हैं। मुहम्मद ज़ख़्मी होकर पीछे हटा, उसकी फ़ौज उत्तर–पश्चिम को लौटती रही, जबकि पृथ्वीराज की सेना मैदान थामे रही।

panels.shot: medium on Prithviraj in camp after battle, calm yet not jubilant, counsellors around, distant fires of a victorious camp
panels.action: That evening, Prithviraj sits beneath a tent awning, armour loosened, as Brahmana advisers and generals stand nearby; beyond them, fires of a Rajput camp burn under the stars.

dialogue.text: The Prithviraja Vijaya celebrates this victory, calling Prithviraj a lion among kings. But it is silent about pursuit. The Ghurid army withdrew, wounded yet unbroken.

i18n.hi: ‘पृथ्वीराज विजय’ इस जीत का गान करती है, उसे राजाओं में शेर कहती है। पर यह पीछा करने पर चुप है; घूरी फ़ौज लहू-लुहान सही, पर टूटी नहीं, लौट गई।

panels.speaker: prithviraj_chauhan_iii_and_muhammad_of_ghor
panels.shot: close-up on Prithviraj, thoughtful, fingers on his sword hilt as advisers talk in the background
panels.action: Prithviraj looks away from his advisers, eyes distant, hand resting lightly on his sheathed sword, as if weighing unseen futures.

dialogue.text: No source shows him chasing the enemy into the Punjab. The year after Tarain opened with Prithviraj in possession of the field, yet the threat from the northwest still alive.

i18n.hi: कहीं नहीं दिखता कि उसने दुश्मन को पंजाब तक खदेड़ा हो। तराइन के बाद का साल पृथ्वीराज के हाथ मैदान से शुरू हुआ, मगर उत्तर–पश्चिम से ख़तरा अब भी ज़िंदा था।

panels.shot: moody interior in Ghurid camp or palace, Muhammad recovering, listening grimly to reports, a Qur'an stand and weapons nearby
panels.action: In a dim chamber, Muhammad of Ghor sits with a bandaged arm, armour set aside, as a commander kneels and reports; beside him rest a sword and a stand holding an open manuscript.

dialogue.text: In Ghurid accounts, that defeat becomes a lesson. Muhammad is shown as vowing not only revenge but reform, resolving to reshape how his army would fight on the plains.

i18n.hi: घूरी लिखावटों में वह हार एक सबक बनती है। मुहम्मद को बदला ही नहीं, सुधार की क़सम खाते दिखाया गया, कि मैदान की जंग के लिए अपनी फ़ौज को नया रूप देगा।

panels.shot: training-yard wide shot of Ghurid cavalry drilling: feigned retreats, archery at the gallop, officers gesturing
panels.action: On an open field, Ghurid horsemen rehearse maneuvers, some galloping past targets and loosing arrows, others simulating retreat and sudden turn, while officers on horseback shout instructions.

dialogue.text: Minhaj-i-Siraj describes a second Tarain fought with greater care. He emphasises that Muhammad reorganised his forces, relying on waves of mounted archers, feigned withdrawals and encirclement rather than a single headlong assault.

i18n.hi: मिनहाज-ए-सिराज दूसरी तराइन को ज़्यादा सोच-समझकर लड़ी गई बताता है। वह लिखता है, मुहम्मद ने लश्कर नया बाँधा, घुड़सवार धनुर्धरों की लहरें, झूठी पलटियाँ और घेराबंदी पर भरोसा किया, न कि एक सीधी दीवानगी भरी टक्कर पर।

panels.shot: contrast panel split: Prithviraj’s court in routine, vs Muhammad assembling a larger force with banners from many regions
panels.action: On the left, Prithviraj holds court in a familiar hall as petitioners and vassals attend; on the right, Muhammad oversees a growing host, banners from Ghur, Ghazni, Lahore and other regions gathering under his command.

dialogue.text: The year between battles passed. Prithviraj’s court poet wrote of victories and gifts. Meanwhile, Muhammad drew contingents from across his domains, turning his next campaign into a broader, more deliberate effort.

i18n.hi: दो जंगों के बीच का साल बीत गया। पृथ्वीराज के दरबारी कवि जीतों और दानों का बखान करते रहे। उधर मुहम्मद ने अपने इलाक़ों से नई टुकड़ियाँ बुलाकर अगला अभियान और बड़ा, और योजनाबद्ध बना दिया।

panels.shot: wide shot of Ghurid army marching again toward India, this time larger and more ordered, camel baggage train in the rear
panels.action: A long Ghurid column advances across the plains, ranks of horsemen in front, spear points glinting, followed by camel caravans and supply carts under a pale sky.

dialogue.text: In 1192, Muhammad marched again. Taj-ul-Maasir presents this as a carefully planned return, with the memory of Tarain’s first outcome shaping every step.

i18n.hi: ११९२ में मुहम्मद फिर चला। ‘ताज-उल-मआसिर’ इसे सोची-समझी वापसी बताती है, जहाँ पहली तराइन की याद हर क़दम पर उसके साथ थी।

panels.shot: re-establishing wide of Tarain plain again, but under different light, with both armies facing off once more
panels.action: Under a harsher sun, the same wells and scrub of Tarain stand between two armies yet again, Rajput banners and elephants on one side, ordered Ghurid cavalry lines on the other.

dialogue.text: Once more, the two forces met on the familiar ground of Tarain. The place that had seen Muhammad’s retreat would now witness Prithviraj’s greatest test.

i18n.hi: फिर वही दो सेनाएँ तराइन की पहचानी ज़मीन पर भिड़ीं। जहाँ कभी मुहम्मद की वापसी देखी गई थी, वहीं अब पृथ्वीराज की सबसे कठिन क़िस्मत लिखनी थी।

panels.shot: medium on Muhammad addressing his commanders before battle, calm and methodical, pointing to formations in the distance
panels.action: On horseback atop a small rise, Muhammad gestures toward the Rajput lines while his commanders lean in, their faces intent, as Ghurid troops shift quietly into pre-arranged positions below.

dialogue.text: According to Minhaj-i-Siraj, Muhammad divided his army and planned repeated attacks and withdrawals, meant to wear down the Rajput host and disrupt its cohesion before any final clash.

i18n.hi: मिनहाज-ए-सिराज के मुताबिक मुहम्मद ने अपनी फ़ौज बाँट दी, और बार–बार हमले–वापसी की योजना बनाई, ताकि राजपूत लश्कर थक जाए और बिखर जाए, फिर आख़िरी टक्कर हो।

panels.shot: sweeping battle-wide: Rajput line charging, Ghurid wings peeling back in feigned retreat while archers keep shooting
panels.action: Rajput horsemen thunder forward in a dense mass, lances levelled, while on the flanks Ghurid cavalry appear to break and ride away, still turning in their saddles to shoot arrows into the charging ranks.

dialogue.text: Persian chroniclers say the Rajput attack drove deep, but each advance found only shifting targets. Feigned retreats drew parts of Prithviraj’s army out, arrows and counter-charges prising his line apart.

i18n.hi: फ़ारसी लेख बताते हैं, राजपूतों का धावा दूर तक धँसा, पर हर बार सामने मज़बूत नहीं, बदलती हुई क़तारें थीं। झूठे पीछे हटने से पृथ्वीराज की फ़ौज के हिस्से खिंच गए, तीर और पलटवार उनकी पंक्तियाँ चीरते गए।

panels.shot: chaotic wide of the battlefield later in the day, Rajput standards scattered, Ghurid troops closing in, elephants milling
panels.action: Dust clouds fill the air as some Rajput standards lie fallen, others isolated, elephants turning confusedly while Ghurid horsemen press in from multiple directions with disciplined formations.

dialogue.text: As the day wore on, Ghurid discipline and mobility told. Accounts describe the Chahamana forces breaking, their famed courage unable to compensate for a battlefield now working against them.

i18n.hi: दिन चढ़ने के साथ घूरी अनुशासन और फुर्ती भारी पड़े। बयान लिखते हैं, चाहमानों की क़तारें टूट गईं, उनका मशहूर साहस भी अब उस मैदान को नहीं मोड़ सका जो उनके ख़िलाफ़ हो चुका था।

panels.shot: somber medium on Prithviraj being seized or led away, weapons taken, watched by Ghurid soldiers and a distant Muhammad
panels.action: Prithviraj, armour dusty, stands with hands bound as Ghurid soldiers surround him, one taking his sword; in the distance, Muhammad of Ghor watches from horseback, expression unreadable.

dialogue.text: Later traditions embroidered his fate with legend. The earlier Persian sources state more simply that Prithviraj was captured after the battle, and that his power in Ajmer and Delhi collapsed.

i18n.hi: बाद की परंपराओं ने उसके अंजाम पर दास्तानें टाँकीं। पहले के फ़ारसी ज़रिए बस इतना कहते हैं कि जंग के बाद पृथ्वीराज क़ैद हुआ, और अजमेर–दिल्ली में उसकी सत्ता ढह गई।

panels.shot: wide shot of Delhi’s skyline with new Ghurid garrison inside, Muhammad’s general on the ramparts, Prithviraj absent
panels.action: The fortifications of Delhi rise under a hazy sky, new Ghurid banners flying over the walls as mailed soldiers look out, while the inner courtyards show unfamiliar arrangements of tents and guards.

dialogue.text: In the aftermath, Ghurid commanders took Delhi and then extended control across parts of the Ganga plain. From these gains would emerge, in time, the Delhi Sultanate.

i18n.hi: इसके बाद घूरी सरदारों ने दिल्ली ली, फिर गंगा के मैदान के हिस्सों पर क़ब्ज़ा फैलाया। इन्हीं फतहों से आगे चलकर दिल्ली सल्तनत उभरी।

panels.shot: reflective split close-up: Prithviraj’s face fading into memory on one side, Muhammad’s face weathered by campaigns on the other
panels.action: On one side, a close profile of Prithviraj fades into a textured backdrop, on the other, Muhammad’s lined face, eyes tired but steady, both framed by the suggestion of the Tarain plain behind them.

dialogue.text: Cynthia Talbot notes that early texts remember Prithviraj as a powerful king whose fall marked a turning point, while Ghurid chronicles cast Muhammad as the ruler who learned from defeat to secure a longer victory.

i18n.hi: सिंथिया टैलबॉट लिखती हैं कि पुराने ग्रंथों में पृथ्वीराज एक शक्तिशाली राजा के रूप में याद है जिसकी गिरावट मोड़ साबित हुई, जबकि घूरी इतिहास मुहम्मद को ऐसा शासक मानते हैं जिसने हार से सीखकर लंबी जीत पक्की की।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide of the empty Tarain plain at sunset, faint ghostly impressions of banners and riders in the sky
panels.action: The battlefield of Tarain lies quiet at sunset, wells and scrub glowing in orange light, while in the sky above, faint translucent shapes of past banners and riders seem to drift and fade.

dialogue.text: Tarain’s two battles show how a single field can reward both courage and adaptation. A victory left unexamined became a lesson for an enemy, and the year between victories reshaped a subcontinent.

i18n.hi: तराइन की दो जंगें दिखाती हैं कि एक ही मैदान बहादुरी और बदलने की कला दोनों को पुरस्कृत कर सकता है। जो जीत टटोली न गई, वही दुश्मन का सबक बनी, और जीतों के बीच का एक साल पूरे उपमहाद्वीप का नक्शा बदल गया।

title_i18n.en: Tarain Twice and the Year Between Victories
title_i18n.hi: तराइन दो बार, और जीतों के बीच एक साल

subtitle_i18n.en: Two Battles, One Field, and a Lesson Unlearned
subtitle_i18n.hi: दो जंग, एक मैदान, और भूला हुआ सबक
